tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App ground and sidebar background, behind the content panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content panel, cards, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control track, empty rows inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between KPI columns and list rows.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card borders: barely there, cards read by whitespace more than by outline.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a wear bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: KPI sublines, captions, axis labels. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Moss. Primary buttons, active nav icon, links, focus ring. The one brand hue.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav row, accent badges. Text on it is ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Gear at 85%+ of its limit: bar fill and status text.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a 'nearly done' badge or banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Over the limit, destructive actions. Small, never a big block.

tokens.name: gear-1
tokens.usage: Gear colour 1 (forest). Dots, chart series, wear-bar fill for that item.

tokens.name: gear-2
tokens.usage: Gear colour 2 (cobalt).

tokens.name: gear-3
tokens.usage: Gear colour 3 (tangerine).

tokens.name: gear-4
tokens.usage: Gear colour 4 (sun).

tokens.name: gear-5
tokens.usage: Gear colour 5 (violet).

tokens.name: gear-6
tokens.usage: Gear colour 6 (teal).

tokens.name: gear-7
tokens.usage: Gear colour 7 (magenta).

tokens.name: gear-other
tokens.usage: Granite. Gear outside the rotation, 'Other' in charts, unassigned activities. Never a gear's own colour.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and nav rows, between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav row padding, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside the panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Content panel padding, page title to content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, nav rows, wear bars (half of a 12px bar).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the content panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, filter chips, wear bars, status chips.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The app window only. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.
